title: Abstract (single paragraph, five elements in order)

intent.statement: Deliver the abstract as exactly ONE self-contained paragraph carrying the five abstract elements in convention order: motivation (unscripted Q&A language read as a window into what managers know but have not disclosed); objective/gap (whether CEO Q&A language tracks an acquisition the firm is still withholding, an uncharacterized cell); data+sample (U.S. public firms' earnings-call transcripts and acquisition records, 2002 to 2018); measure+setting (a residual measure of CEO Q&A uncertainty net of each executive's persistent speaking style, studied around cash acquisitions against a stock placebo); and qualitative findings + contribution (the pre-cash run-up, indistinguishable from zero once announced, cash-concentrated on a formal pooled test, not explained by analyst scrutiny, read as call language tracking the disclosure state). [RECONCILED 2026-06-24: final_prose also carries the Section 4.2 bid-ask channel sentence, homed as prop abstract-P1-i.]
intent.reason: The ABSTRACT convention mandates exactly one single highly-compressed paragraph delivering five elements in order, qualitative and citation-free; the locked AB chain already realizes all five in sequence (AB.1=el.1, AB.2=el.2, AB.3=el.3, AB.4=el.4, AB.5..AB.8=el.5), so the only allocation decision is to home the entire chain in one paragraph in element order, with the correlational ceiling carried implicitly by the AB.8 contribution close (the abstract convention has no honesty-caveat move).
evidence: DraftTemplate.txt L33-54 (ABSTRACT = one single paragraph, 5 elements in order, QUALITATIVE, no citations/coefficients/equations/roadmap, numbers only for sample scale)

paragraphs.boundary: NAMES the measure DESCRIPTIVELY and the cash/stock setting; carries ZERO citations and ZERO author names (no DWZ); no equations or notation; no coefficients/SEs/p-values/t-stats/economic-magnitude percentages; no roadmap. Points at nothing in Section 2 (the abstract stands alone). Sample-scale numerals only (years; optional 88,205 calls / 1,884 firms). No standalone caveat sentence; the ceiling stays implicit in AB.8.
paragraphs.thin_claim: A within-firm correlational regularity: residual CEO Q&A uncertainty is elevated before cash acquisitions (not stock), indistinguishable from zero once announced, cash-concentrated on a formal pooled test, not explained by analyst scrutiny; read as call language tracking the disclosure state, no tested mechanism, no identification. [RECONCILED 2026-06-24: ALSO carries the Section 4.2 bid-ask channel sentence (prop abstract-P1-i); findings = C2/C1/C6/C4 + this channel finding; see _DRIFT_AUDIT_2026-06-24.md.] Ceiling kept IMPLICIT (abstract convention has no honesty move).
guardrails: ZERO citations and ZERO author names (abstract-citation rule); measure named descriptively only (DWZ and all names live in the intro and Section 2).

C1 (AB.6): lead with 'indistinguishable from zero once the deal is announced' at the GAP; NEVER 'unwound/reverses/falls' as the headline verb (red-team flagged this on plan2 AB.6); 'fully unwound' is the peak-to-completion swing in the body, NOT the GAP; do NOT read the negative POST.
C6 (AB.7): phrase ONLY as the formal pooled (Wald) difference that survives; NEVER the Gelman-Stern 'significant for cash vs not for stock' side-by-side; concentration not strict specificity.
C4 (AB.8): 'not explained by analysts devoting more of the call to cash questions' = does not account for THIS run-up; NEVER 'scrutiny never matters'.
E1: no generated-regressand / Pagan / two-step-SE disclaimer anywhere in the abstract.
No coefficient/SE/p-value/t-stat/economic-magnitude percentage in any statement; numbers confined to sample scale (years; optional N).

C3 (dropped 2026-06-14) and C5 EPU/PRisk-index convergent validity NOT elevated (the abstract carries no EPU/PRisk sentence). EXCEPTION added 2026-06-24 (user-authorized): the Section 4.2 bid-ask CHANNEL finding (residual inert to the post-call spread; scripted presentation positively associated) IS carried, homed as abstract-P1-i, stated as two per-component facts and NEVER as a tested between-component difference (Section 4.2 register_global). Findings capped to C2/C1/C6/C4 PLUS this channel sentence.
Ceiling kept IMPLICIT: add NO standalone caveat sentence (abstract convention has no honesty move).

proposition_chain.reason: The convention places motivation/prior practice first; AB.1 is the chain's framing opener and must lead the single paragraph to establish the venue the gap (AB.2) and everything after depend on.

proposition_chain.statement: This residual uncertainty is elevated in the quarter before a cash acquisition, relative to the firm's own other quarters, with no comparable rise before stock acquisitions.

proposition_chain.reason: Element 5 opens the findings with the foundational run-up (C2): the elevation must be established before the announcement-timing contrast (AB.6) and the formal cash-concentration test (AB.7) can build on it. The stock side here is the descriptive contrast, distinct from the formal test in AB.7.
